# Blocks Catalog

Every block_type usable in NodeXOps PDPs / pages / blog posts.

Common fields on every block: `block_type` (str), `titulo` (str), `texto` (str), `media` (str URL), `layout` (str), `img_size`, `img_width`, `video_size`, `icon_grid_cols`, `icon_grid_show_names` (bool, default `true`), `icon_grid_icon_size` (`s`|`m`|`l`|`xl`|`custom`, default `m`), `icon_grid_icon_size_px` (int, only used when `icon_grid_icon_size='custom'`).

The `texto` field varies by block_type — for the JSON-shaped types listed below, send `texto` as a JSON-encoded string.

## text-image

**Label in UI:** Contenido
**Icon:** ▣

**`texto` shape:** string (markdown supported)

## accordion

**Label in UI:** Acordeón
**Icon:** ▤

**`texto` shape:** `[{"q": "...", "a": "..."}]` JSON-encoded array

## icon-grid

**Label in UI:** Grilla de Iconos
**Icon:** ◉

**`texto` shape:** `[{"name": "...", "image_url": "...", "link": "https://...", "target": "_blank"}]` JSON-encoded array — `link` (optional) wraps the icon in `<a>`, `target` defaults to `_blank`

## gallery

**Label in UI:** Galería
**Icon:** ⊞

**`texto` shape:** `{"images": [...], "text": "..."}` JSON-encoded object

## button

**Label in UI:** Botón
**Icon:** ▶

**`texto` shape:** `{"url": "...", "target": "_self", "align": "center"}` JSON-encoded

## video

**Label in UI:** Galería de Video
**Icon:** ◮

**`texto` shape:** `{"videos": [{"url": "...", "title": "..."}]}` JSON-encoded

## spacer

**Label in UI:** Espaciado
**Icon:** ⬍

**`texto` shape:** (unused)

## table

**Label in UI:** Tabla
**Icon:** ⊞

**`texto` shape:** `{"rows": N, "cols": N, "cells": [[...]], "has_header": bool}` JSON-encoded

## structure

**Label in UI:** Estructura
**Icon:** ▥

**`texto` shape:** string

## Column-child subtypes

The following `block_type` values are valid only as children inside a `columns` block.

## text-only (also valid as a column-child subtype)

**`texto` shape:** string (markdown supported)

## media-only (also valid as a column-child subtype)

**`texto` shape:** string (markdown supported)

## highlight (also valid as a column-child subtype)

**`texto` shape:** string (markdown supported)
